title: Style sheets (CSS)
description:
Every element of a dashboard can be styled: the header, panels and their titles, a
chart and its parts (title, plot, axis, label, legend, series, value, ...), table rows
and cells. The top-level `style` applies to every panel, a panel's `style` to its own
elements only. Try `:DbDashStyle set value color DiagnosticOk`. See `:help dbdash-css`.

query.sql: SELECT 'North' AS region, 120 AS sales UNION ALL SELECT 'South', 80 UNION ALL SELECT 'East', 95 UNION ALL SELECT 'West', 60

show.title: series, value, label colors
show.description:
A chart's parts are elements: `series { color }` colors the data, `value` the
numbers, `label` the categories.

query.sql: SELECT 'North' AS region, 120 AS sales UNION ALL SELECT 'South', 80 UNION ALL SELECT 'East', 95 UNION ALL SELECT 'West', 60

show.title: panel { background-color, padding }
show.description:
The panel's box: `background-color`, and `padding` like CSS (`[1, 2]`: one line
above and below, two columns left and right).

query.sql: SELECT 'North' AS region, 120 AS sales UNION ALL SELECT 'South', 80 UNION ALL SELECT 'East', 95 UNION ALL SELECT 'West', 60

show.title: panel { border, border-color }
show.description:
A box around the panel (`border`: single, rounded, heavy, double, dashed or ascii)
with the title in its top line, like a fieldset; `border-color` colors it.

query.sql: SELECT 'North' AS region, 120 AS sales UNION ALL SELECT 'South', 80 UNION ALL SELECT 'East', 95 UNION ALL SELECT 'West', 60

show.title: plot { border: double }, axis { color }
show.description:
The plot's own frame (`plot { border }`: single, rounded, heavy, double, dashed,
ascii or none) and the tick labels' color (`axis { color }`).

query.sql: SELECT 'North' AS region, 120 AS sales UNION ALL SELECT 'South', 80 UNION ALL SELECT 'East', 95 UNION ALL SELECT 'West', 60

show.title: axis { display: none }, plot { border: none }
show.description:
`display: none` takes an element out: `axis` hides the tick labels and axis titles,
`plot { border: none }` the frame.

query.sql: SELECT 'North' AS region, 120 AS sales UNION ALL SELECT 'South', 80 UNION ALL SELECT 'East', 95 UNION ALL SELECT 'West', 60

show.title: #highlighted: legend, title
show.description:
This panel's id is `highlighted`: the top-level rule `"#highlighted panel-title"`
colors its title. Its own `legend { color }` colors the legend labels, and
`panel-title { text-decoration: underline }` adds to the cascade.

query.sql: SELECT 'North' AS region, 120 AS sales UNION ALL SELECT 'South', 80 UNION ALL SELECT 'East', 95 UNION ALL SELECT 'West', 60

show.title: justify-self / align-self: center
show.description:
Where the chart sits in its cell: `justify-self` start, center, end or stretch;
`align-self` start, center or end. `value { font-weight, color }` styles the digits.

query.sql: SELECT 'North' AS region, 120 AS sales UNION ALL SELECT 'South', 80 UNION ALL SELECT 'East', 95 UNION ALL SELECT 'West', 60

show.title: panel-title { text-align: right }
show.description: The title's position: `text-align` left, center or right.

query.sql: SELECT 'North' AS region, 120 AS sales UNION ALL SELECT 'South', 80 UNION ALL SELECT 'East', 95 UNION ALL SELECT 'West', 60

show.title: panel-title { display: none } (this title is hidden)
show.description: `display: none` on the title; K still shows this description.

query.sql: SELECT 'North' AS region, 120 AS sales UNION ALL SELECT 'South', NULL UNION ALL SELECT 'East', 95 UNION ALL SELECT 'West', 60

show.title: table, cell, row:nth-child(even)
show.description:
A table with one line style (`table { border: rounded }`), no cell padding
(`cell { padding: 0 }`, Bootstrap `.table-sm`), every other row shaded
(`row:nth-child(even)`, Bootstrap `.table-striped`) and NULL in its own color
(`cell.null`).

query.sql: SELECT 'a long text that wraps inside its column' AS text, 'top' AS a

show.title: cell { vertical-align, height }
show.description:
Long cells wrap (`white-space: normal`); a short cell in a tall row sits by
`vertical-align` (top, middle, bottom); `column_list[].align` aligns one column.
`cell { height: 3 }` keeps at most three lines per cell; the rest ends with "…".

query.sql: SELECT 'a long text that does not fit in one line' AS text

show.title: cell { white-space: nowrap, text-overflow }
show.description:
`white-space: nowrap` keeps one line and cuts it with `text-overflow` ("…" by
default, here "..."); `cell { width }` sets every column's width.

query.sql:
SELECT 'North' AS region, 120 AS sales UNION ALL SELECT 'South', 80
UNION ALL SELECT 'East', 95 UNION ALL SELECT 'West', 60

show.title: one item: cell:first-child, row:last-child
show.description:
A table is elements as in HTML: `table > header, row > cell`, one row per result
row. Structural selectors pick one: `cell:first-child` is the first column,
`row:last-child` the last row (a total line, say).

query.sql:
SELECT 'Books' AS category, 240 AS sales UNION ALL SELECT 'Food', 700
UNION ALL SELECT 'Home', 480 UNION ALL SELECT 'Sports', 350

show.title: one bar: bar[category=Books], legend items
show.description:
Every bar is an element with its category and series (`bar[category=Books]`, or
`bar.Books`) and a `value` inside: color one bar and its label, or hide one value
(`bar[category=Food] value { display: none }`).

query.sql:
SELECT 'Engineering' AS dept, 52 AS n UNION ALL SELECT 'Sales', 31
UNION ALL SELECT 'Support', 17 UNION ALL SELECT 'Admin', 8

show.title: legend-item:nth-child(2)
show.description:
A legend is `legend > legend-item`, each with `label`, `value` and `percent`
inside (pie charts): `legend-item:nth-child(2) label` styles the second label,
`legend-item percent { display: none }` hides every percentage.
